title: Soda Failures by Dataset
app: soda-core scan results and Soda Cloud API events forwarded as JSON to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=soda:scan check_outcome="fail"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dataset
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Soda failures grouped by dataset so operators immediately see which specific datasets are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Soda is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Soda failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical datasets.
visualization: Table of dataset by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Soda are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
